› Profile the checkout handler under load.

• Load test: 200 rps for 5 minutes. p99 latency 840 ms (target 300 ms).

• 70% of the time is one SQL query: the coupon lookup has no index on (code, active), so
  every checkout scans 400k coupons. An index should bring p99 under 200 ms. That
  matters because checkout p99 over 500 ms is when cart abandonment rises. I changed
  nothing.
